# GradleMCP
> Self-hosted asynchronous Docker-isolated Gradle builds for AI agents.
- Agent workflow: docs/AI_GUIDE.md
- Machine API: docs/openapi.json
- MCP integration: docs/MCP.md
- Security and limitations: docs/SECURITY_MODEL.md
- Operations/UI: README.md, docs/INSTALLATION.md
REST base: /api/v1; first call authenticated GET /api/v1/capabilities.
Remote MCP: Streamable HTTP at /mcp/ (trailing slash), with Authorization: Bearer <token>; stdio is also supported.
